description: Land Title Settlement Department - Thudella, Ja-ela D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 512200
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed declarations of land title determinations for specific parcels of land, including parcel numbers, owner names, extent of land, encumbrances, and other land-related particulars. The content falls under PART III - LANDS and involves the Commissioner of Title Settlement making determinations about land ownership and registration, which squarely fits the Land Gazette classification (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
